situation: The payments API returns errors for all customers. Error rate rose from 0% to 100% in six minutes and the cause is not known.

gate.reason: The team is starting a root-cause meeting. Stability must come first.

pieces.name: Payments API total failure
evidence: Every payment request fails and revenue loss is running now.
Three alerts fired at once and no change record links to the cause.

second_reading.tipping_condition: A rollback restores service and the cause becomes a normal investigation.

pieces.boundary_risk: Staying in act mode after stability returns. Move to analysis once errors stop.

approach.summary: Restore service first. Defer root-cause analysis.
approach.stabilising_action: Roll back the most recent release on the payments service now.
approach.sense_after: Error rate and p95 latency for 15 minutes after rollback. Then decide: investigate or escalate.

reclassify_triggers: Error rate drops to normal. Reclassify the cause as Complicated and open a post-incident review.
The rollback has no effect. Choose the next stabilising action. Do not start analysis yet.
